name: [UPD] Poly Drifters
desc:
🔥 Welcome to Poly Drifters! 🔥

Jump into a fast-paced drifting experience where style, control, and precision earn you cash. Drift through corners, chain huge drift combos, and build your dream car collection!

🚧 EARLY DEVELOPMENT
This game is still being actively developed — expect updates, new cars, and improvements! Some bugs may occur.

🏎️ FEATURES

💨 Smooth, satisfying drifting mechanics
💸 Earn cash from drift score combos
🚗 Unlock and collect unique cars
🎨 Custom tire smoke & tuning options
🌆 Open maps perfect for car meets & free driving
📈 Progression system with upgrades and rewards

🎮 CONTROLS

W, A, S, D — Drive
H — Headlights
Shift + P — Freecam

🔥 WHY PLAY?
Master your drifting skills, show off your style, and compete for the highest scores.

🙏 Inspired by: Mall Drifters / Mini Drifters

🏁 TAGS
drift, drifting, drift simulator, car game, driving, racing, cars, tuning, customization, multiplayer, car meet, open world, drifting game
